description: This file defines the 'Loader' class within the OpenCart e-commerce framework. The class provides methods for dynamically loading controllers, models, views, languages, libraries, configuration files, and helpers, managing dependencies and event triggers in an MVC architecture.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: The Loader class manages loading and instantiation of controllers, models, views, languages, libraries, configurations, and helpers, and coordinates event triggering around these operations within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Loader with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Provides dynamic access to registry entries via property-style access.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Allows setting registry entries via property-style assignment.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Loads a controller based on a sanitized route, executes a method with arguments, and triggers pre- and post-events.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Loads a model class, wraps it in a proxy, and registers it for further use.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Loads a template/view, triggers pre- and post-events, and returns the generated HTML.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Loads language translations for a specified route and triggers associated events.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Loads a library class, registers it, and returns it.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Loads configuration data for a route, with event triggers.

methods.name: helper
methods.description: Includes helper PHP files based on the route after sanitization.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callable closure wrapping a model method, with event triggering and error handling.
